clips.title: The story
paras: Following the creation of his experimental Shimmer Stout in Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew asks travelers to carry a fresh barrel out to his brother Wellart. Wellart serves as a dwarf Mountaineer stationed at the southern guard tower guarding the pass toward Loch Modan, where a cold post makes a strong drink all the more welcome.

Rejold Barleybrew has perfected his new creation, Shimmer Stout, using shimmering fronds gathered from the icy crags of Dun Morogh. While the rest of the Barleybrew family dedicates their craft to the vats and kegs of Brewnall Village, Rejold's brother Wellart chose the life of a Mountaineer. Knowing the lonely conditions of guard duty on the frontier, Rejold sends a fresh barrel along with passing travelers as both a brotherly favor and a true taste test.

Wellart Barleybrew is stationed at the southern guard tower flanking the South Gate Pass into Loch Modan. High atop the mountain pass, the Mountaineers endure bitter winds and occasional beast attacks while keeping watch over travelers walking the mountain road. Running low on drink and restless for excitement, Wellart finds that Shimmer Stout delivers quite a punch—so much so that it seems to brighten his vision in the dim mountain night.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout. He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.
He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.
Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, Shaman! And what business takes you all the way out here?
Something exciting, I hope. I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh. Whoa! This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. I feel like I can see in the dark!
